name: manual
title: Manual
description: A documentation handbook that keeps a numbered section index beside every page and a title block above it, with a single amber marker for the section you are reading, so a reader always knows exactly where they are.

tokens.--font-ui: all interface and body text (system sans stack)
tokens.--font-mono: code, section numbers and the small uppercase labels
tokens.--text-xs: small uppercase labels: breadcrumb, table headers, Previous and Next
tokens.--text-s: contents list, menu, descriptions, code blocks, footer
tokens.--text-l: site title, the sentence under a page title, h3, and titles and numbers in the section index
tokens.--text-code: inline code and keyboard keys, relative to the text around them
tokens.--tracking-label: letter-spacing of the small uppercase labels
tokens.--color-panel: white wayfinding panels: masthead, title block, contents list, search box, Previous and Next cards
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: descriptions, labels, section numbers, list bullets
tokens.--color-accent: links, focus rings, hover states, titles in the section index and on Previous and Next cards
tokens.--color-signal: the amber you-are-here marker and nothing else: current menu entry, title-block edge, current row of the contents list
tokens.--color-border: thin edges around panels, code blocks and table rows
tokens.--color-border-strong: structural rules: masthead, top of the section index, table headers, the edge of a note
tokens.--color-chip-bg: inline code background and the current row of the contents list
tokens.--measure: maximum width of the page column (titles, code blocks and tables)
tokens.--measure-text: longest line of running text; code and tables may run wider
tokens.--sidebar-w: width of the contents list beside the page
tokens.--space-1: gap between a label and its title; padding of contents-list rows
tokens.--space-2: padding inside panels, the title block and table cells
tokens.--space-3: page gutter and the gap between blocks of text
tokens.--space-4: space under the masthead and the title block; gap between sections of a page
tokens.--space-5: gap between the contents list and the page; space above Previous and Next and the footer
tokens.--tap: minimum height of things you tap: menu links, search box, title block, contents rows on a phone
tokens.--radius: corner rounding on panels, code and focus rings
tokens.--rule: thickness of structural rules, the amber marker and focus rings
tokens.--hairline: thickness of thin edges on panels, rows and code blocks
